description: Stop physical token movement from producing automatic Boost, Overcharge, or excess-movement notifications while preserving movement tracking and UI presentation.
planning_goal: Preserve existing movement measurement, movement tracking, elevation tracking, and movement UI presentation. Remove the movement-feature calls that notify the player about automatic Boost, automatic Overcharge, or excess movement after horizontal token movement. Remove the equivalent automatic-action and excess-movement notification calls after elevation movement. Preserve movement measurement failure warnings and the informational elevation-recorded notification.
